title: UCT Problem for Separable Nuclear Complex C*-Algebras
exact_target: Does operator K-theory, together with its extension term, compute KK-theory through the canonical universal coefficient sequence for every separable nuclear complex C*-algebra?

sources.citation: Selcuk Barlak and Xin Li, Cartan Subalgebras and the UCT Problem, arXiv1511.02697v3,21June2017,18pages.
